title: Alpha Desk V3 Gold Scientific Constitution
mission: Define the complete Gold knowledge universe and scientific decision boundaries before live acquisition or V3 decision authority exists.

invariants.rule: Target Gold price/return/technical pattern cannot create, strengthen, weaken, reverse, validate or consume causal Pressure.
Price may change transmission/model-completeness/missing-driver risk, never causal Pressure directly.
Knowledge intake is exhaustive; only causally owned independent roots may influence causal Direction.
A common shock cannot be counted again through dependent rates, USD, flows or price responses.
Volume/activity is not signed transaction pressure.
Open interest is outstanding exposure/activity state, not direction by itself.
ETF AUM price effects must be separated from creations/redemptions/holdings changes.
CFTC positioning is lagged regulated-futures positioning, never live global Gold flow.
LBMA clearing activity is not client/dealer directional flow.
Aggregate options OI does not identify dealer sign/inventory.
COMEX, London OTC, ETF and regional physical markets are distinct subsets.
Proxy evidence must remain labeled and can never silently replace a private/direct observation gap.
Missing, unavailable, stale and private facts are not neutral observations.
User-facing numeric strength/probability/consumption/persistence scores are forbidden unless an empirical calibration reference exists.
Every future V3 observation must preserve event/reference/publish/first-seen/retrieval/revision lineage.
Price/pressure divergence requires opposing-root and missing-driver search before any latent imbalance claim.
Slow structural facts may condition priors/persistence but cannot be relabeled as intraday flow.
Perspective/fragility layers may stress-test but never set Direction.

pressure_planes.meaning: Independent causal forces and expectation states that create directional incentive before target price response.
Observed transaction/ownership transfer pressure such as verified ETF/official/physical or defensibly classified participant changes.
Forced or rule-driven pressure including liquidation, margin, hedging, roll, expiry, rebalance and capacity effects.
Slow persistent state including reserve diversification, official accumulation, supply structure and long-run credibility.
